query.name: us.ma.k12.lawrence.classdojo.users
query.sql:
with yearquery as (select id, abbreviation from terms where portion = 1 AND terms.lastday > sysdate AND sysdate > terms.firstday-30 AND schoolid=0 ), TeacherorgSource as (select users.dcid as dcid, case cast(schoolstaff.SchoolID as varchar2(10)) when '0' then cast((select prefs.value from prefs where prefs.name = 'districtnumber') as varchar2(10)) else cast(schoolstaff.SchoolID as varchar2(10)) end as SchoolID from users join schoolstaff on schoolstaff.users_dcid = users.dcid and schoolstaff.status = 1 and schoolstaff.staffstatus = 1 and schoolstaff.schoolid != users.homeschoolid ), TeacherorgSourceh as (select users.dcid as dcid, case cast(schoolstaff.SchoolID as varchar2(10)) when '0' then cast((select prefs.value from prefs where prefs.name = 'districtnumber') as varchar2(10)) else cast(schoolstaff.SchoolID as varchar2(10)) end as SchoolID from users join schoolstaff on schoolstaff.users_dcid = users.dcid and schoolstaff.schoolid = users.homeschoolid ), TeacherorgSourceGroup as (select users.dcid, case when (LISTAGG(TeacherorgSource.SchoolID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY TeacherorgSource.SchoolID)) is null then cast(TeacherorgSourceh.SchoolID as varchar2(10)) else TeacherorgSourceh.SchoolID||','||(LISTAGG(TeacherorgSource.SchoolID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY TeacherorgSource.SchoolID)) end as orgSourcedIds from users join (select * from TeacherorgSourceh) TeacherorgSourceh on TeacherorgSourceh.dcid = users.dcid left join (select * from TeacherorgSource) TeacherorgSource on TeacherorgSource.dcid = users.dcid join schoolstaff on schoolstaff.users_dcid = users.dcid and schoolstaff.schoolid = users.homeschoolid
group by users.dcid, TeacherorgSourceh.SchoolID ), StudentorgSource as (select distinct students.dcid, cc.schoolid from students join cc on students.id = cc.studentid join yearquery on 1=1 join sections on cc.sectionid = sections.id join teachers t on sections.teacher=t.id and t.ptaccess = 1 and t.status = 1 and t.StaffStatus = 1 where students.enroll_status = 0 and cc.schoolid != students.schoolid and (cc.termid between yearquery.id and yearquery.id+99) and cc.dateleft > cc.dateenrolled ), StudentorgSourceh as (select students.dcid, students.schoolid from students ), StudentorgSourceGroup as (select students.dcid, case when (LISTAGG(StudentorgSource.SchoolID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY StudentorgSource.SchoolID)) is null then cast(StudentorgSourceh.SchoolID as varchar2(10)) else StudentorgSourceh.SchoolID||','||(LISTAGG(StudentorgSource.SchoolID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY StudentorgSource.SchoolID)) end as orgSourcedIds from students join (select * from StudentorgSourceh) StudentorgSourceh on StudentorgSourceh.dcid = students.dcid left join (select * from StudentorgSource) StudentorgSource on StudentorgSource.dcid = students.dcid
group by students.dcid, StudentorgSourceh.SchoolID ), StudentEmail as (select psc.email as email, stu.dcid as dcid from PSM_STudentcontact psc join psm_studentcontacttype psct on psc.studentcontacttypeid = psct.id and psct.name = 'Self' join sync_studentmap ssm on psc.studentid = ssm.studentid join students stu on ssm.studentsdcid = stu.dcid ), studenttocontact as (select students.dcid, person.id from students join studentcontactassoc on students.dcid = studentcontactassoc.studentdcid join person on studentcontactassoc.personID = person.id join PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT on person.id = PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT.CONTACTPERSONID and studentcontactassoc.STUDENTCONTACTASSOCID = PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT.STUDENTCONTACTASSOCID and students.dcid = PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT.STUDENTDCID left join GuardianPersonAssoc on person.id = GuardianPersonAssoc.PersonID left join guardian on guardianpersonassoc.guardianid = guardian.guardianid left join GuardianStudent on students.dcid = GuardianStudent.StudentsDCID and Guardian.guardianid=GuardianStudent.GuardianID where (PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT.ISCUSTODIAL = 1 or PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT.LIVESWITHFLG = 1 OR GuardianStudent.GuardianID is not null) and students.enroll_status in (0,-1) ), studenttocontactGroup as (select students.dcid, -- listagg() creates comma-separated aggregate list for all linked contacts, then replace() removes those that don't have an account case when (replace(listagg('C'||studenttocontact.id,',') within group (ORDER BY students.dcid),'C,','')) = 'C' then null else (replace(listagg('C'||studenttocontact.id,',') within group (ORDER BY students.dcid),'C,','')) end as agentSourcedIds from students left join (select * from studenttocontact ) studenttocontact on studenttocontact.dcid = students.dcid Group by students.dcid ), contacttostudents as (select person.id, studentcontactassoc.studentdcid from person join studentcontactassoc on person.id = studentcontactassoc.personID join StudentContactDetail on studentcontactassoc.StudentContactAssocID = StudentContactDetail.StudentContactAssocID join students on studentcontactassoc.studentdcid = students.dcid join PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT on person.id = PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT.CONTACTPERSONID and studentcontactassoc.STUDENTCONTACTASSOCID = PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT.STUDENTCONTACTASSOCID and students.dcid = PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT.STUDENTDCID left join GuardianPersonAssoc on person.id = GuardianPersonAssoc.PersonID left join guardian on guardianpersonassoc.guardianid = guardian.guardianid left join GuardianStudent on students.dcid = GuardianStudent.StudentsDCID and Guardian.guardianid=GuardianStudent.GuardianID where (PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT.ISCUSTODIAL = 1 or PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT.LIVESWITHFLG = 1 OR GuardianStudent.GuardianID is not null) and students.enroll_status in (0,-1) ), contacttostudentGroup as (select person.id, case when (replace(listagg('S'||contacttostudents.studentdcid,',') within group (ORDER BY person.id),'S,','')) = 'S' then null else (replace(listagg('S'||contacttostudents.studentdcid,',') within group (ORDER BY person.id),'S,','')) end as agentSourcedIds from person left join (select * from contacttostudents) contacttostudents on contacttostudents.id = person.id group by person.id ), contacttostudentSchool as (select person.id, case when (listagg(DISTINCT students.schoolid,',') within group (ORDER BY person.id)) is null then cast((select prefs.value from prefs where prefs.name = 'districtnumber') as varchar2(10)) else (listagg( DISTINCT students.schoolid,',') within group (ORDER BY person.id)) end as orgSourcedIds from person join (select * from contacttostudents) contacttostudents on contacttostudents.id = person.id join students on students.dcid = contacttostudents.studentdcid group by person.id ), PSSIS_Person_PhoneLand_Group as (select PSSIS_Person_Phone.PersonID, PSSIS_Person_Phone.PhoneNumber, PSSIS_Person_Phone.PhoneNumberExt, PSSIS_Person_Phone.PhoneType, row_number () over ( partition by PersonID order by IsPreferred DESC,PhoneNumberPriorityOrder ASC ) rn from PSSIS_Person_Phone where ISSMS = 0 and PhoneNumberExt IS NULL ), PSSIS_Person_PhoneLand as (select PSSIS_Person_PhoneLand_Group.PersonID, PSSIS_Person_PhoneLand_Group.PhoneNumber, PSSIS_Person_PhoneLand_Group.PhoneNumberExt, PSSIS_Person_PhoneLand_Group.PhoneType from PSSIS_Person_PhoneLand_Group where PSSIS_Person_PhoneLand_Group.rn = 1 ), PSSIS_Person_PhoneSMS_Group as (select PSSIS_Person_Phone.PersonID, PSSIS_Person_Phone.PhoneNumber, PSSIS_Person_Phone.PhoneNumberExt, PSSIS_Person_Phone.PhoneType, row_number () over ( partition by PersonID order by IsPreferred DESC,PhoneNumberPriorityOrder ASC ) rn from PSSIS_Person_Phone where ISSMS = 1 and PhoneNumberExt IS NULL ), PSSIS_Person_PhoneSMS as (select PSSIS_Person_PhoneSMS_Group.PersonID, PSSIS_Person_PhoneSMS_Group.PhoneNumber, PSSIS_Person_PhoneSMS_Group.PhoneNumberExt, PSSIS_Person_PhoneSMS_Group.PhoneType from PSSIS_Person_PhoneSMS_Group where PSSIS_Person_PhoneSMS_Group.rn = 1 ), PSSIS_Person_Email_Group as (select PSSIS_Person_Email.PersonID, PSSIS_Person_Email.EmailAddress, PSSIS_Person_Email.EmailType, row_number () over ( partition by PersonID order by IsPrimaryEmailAddress DESC,EmailAddressPriorityOrder ASC ) rn from PSSIS_Person_Email ), PSSIS_Person_Email1 as (select PSSIS_Person_Email_Group.PersonID, PSSIS_Person_Email_Group.EmailAddress, PSSIS_Person_Email_Group.EmailType from PSSIS_Person_Email_Group where PSSIS_Person_Email_Group.rn = 1 ), PersonLanguageAssoc_Group as (select person.id, Codeset.Code, row_number () over ( partition by person.id order by PersonLanguageAssoc.LANGUAGEPRIORITYORDER ASC ) rn from person join PersonLanguageAssoc on person.id = PersonLanguageAssoc.PERSONID join Codeset on PersonLanguageAssoc.LANGUAGECODESETID = Codeset.CODESETID ), PersonLanguageAssoc1 as (select PersonLanguageAssoc_Group.ID, PersonLanguageAssoc_Group.code from PersonLanguageAssoc_Group where PersonLanguageAssoc_Group.rn = 1 ) -- teachers select 'T'||users.dcid as sourcedId, TeacherorgSourceGroup.orgSourcedIds, 'teacher' as role, users.first_name as givenName, users.last_name as familyName, users.email_addr as email, null as agentSourcedIds, null as guardian_sms, null as guardian_phone, null as staff_sms, null as staff_phone, null as grades, null as primary_language from users left join (select * from TeacherorgSourceGroup) TeacherorgSourceGroup on TeacherorgSourceGroup.dcid = users.dcid join schoolstaff on schoolstaff.users_dcid = users.dcid left join teachers on teachers.users_dcid = users.dcid AND teachers.schoolId = users.homeSchoolId where users.homeschoolid = schoolstaff.schoolid and BITAND(schoolstaff.status, schoolstaff.staffstatus)+0 = 1
union all
-- students select 'S'||students.dcid as sourcedId, StudentorgSourceGroup.orgSourcedIds, 'student' as role, students.first_name as givenName, students.last_name as familyName, StudentEmail.email as email, studenttocontactGroup.agentSourcedIds, null as guardian_sms, null as guardian_phone, null as staff_sms, null as staff_phone, case when students.grade_level <= -3 then 'IT' when students.grade_level between -2 and -1 then 'PK' when students.grade_level = 0 then 'KG' when students.grade_level between 1 and 13 then trim(to_char(students.grade_level,'00')) when students.grade_level > 13 then 'PS' else 'Other' end as grades, null as primary_language from students join schools on students.schoolid = schools.school_number -- School join graph join (select * from StudentorgSourceGroup) StudentorgSourceGroup on StudentorgSourceGroup.dcid = students.dcid -- student email join graph left join (select * from StudentEmail) StudentEmail on StudentEmail.dcid = students.dcid -- multi-guardian join graph join (select * from studenttocontactGroup) studenttocontactGroup on studenttocontactGroup.dcid = students.dcid where students.enroll_status in (0,-1)
union all
-- Contacts select 'C'||person.id as sourcedId, contacttostudentSchool.orgSourcedIds, 'guardian' as role, person.firstname as givenName, person.lastname as familyName, -- pcas_emailcontact.emailaddress as email, case when pcas_emailcontact.pcas_accountid Is Not Null then pcas_emailcontact.emailaddress else PSSIS_Person_Email1.EmailAddress end as email, contacttostudentGroup.agentSourcedIds, PSSIS_Person_PhoneSMS.PhoneNumber as guardian_sms, PSSIS_Person_PhoneLand.PhoneNumber as guardian_phone, null as staff_sms, null as staff_phone, null as grades, PersonLanguageAssoc1.Code as primary_language from person join (select * from contacttostudentSchool) contacttostudentSchool on contacttostudentSchool.id = person.id join (select * from contacttostudentGroup) contacttostudentGroup on contacttostudentGroup.id = person.id LEFT JOIN PSSIS_Person_PhoneSMS ON PSSIS_Person_PhoneSMS.PersonID = person.id LEFT JOIN PSSIS_Person_PhoneLand ON PSSIS_Person_PhoneLand.PersonID = person.id LEFT JOIN PSSIS_Person_Email1 ON PSSIS_Person_Email1.PersonID = person.id LEFT JOIN PersonLanguageAssoc1 ON PersonLanguageAssoc1.ID = person.id left join GuardianPersonAssoc on person.id = GuardianPersonAssoc.PersonID left join guardian on guardianpersonassoc.guardianid = guardian.guardianid left join pcas_account on GUARDIAN.accountidentifier = pcas_account.pcas_accounttoken left join pcas_emailcontact on pcas_account.pcas_accountID = pcas_emailcontact.pcas_accountid where person.IsActive = 1
